name: @gcu/gsjs
description: Modern geostatistics for the browser — the evolving sibling to the frozen @gcu/gslib oracle. Exposes intermediate kriging state (the BlockEstimateTensor: weights + sample indices + variance + status), GPU-accelerated realization + aggregation, and a decoupled search neighborhood. JS-on-browser brokers WebGPU + runtime-compiled atra/WASM.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
